history.reason: Mega Dragon Dance Dragonite and +1 Extreme Speed dictated the midgame; Scarf Garchomp outspeeds +1 setup sweepers before they snowball and gives a turn-1 revenge option that Sitrus does not.

Kingambit was neutralized by Will-O-Wisp and Parting Shot chains this game; Clear Amulet blocks the stat drops from Parting Shot/Intimidate-style pressure and keeps our slow attacker relevant against Grimmsnarl/Sableye support cores (Defiant rarely triggered anyway in these matchups since they use Parting Shot on Whimsicott instead).
Rain/Archaludon games need an immediate revenge-KO speed tier; Scarf Garchomp remains the only piece that can outspeed and threaten boosted sweepers before they fire.

Kingambit keeps arriving chipped and dying with low damage contributed; Clear Amulet also blanks Rock Tomb/Icy Wind speed drops and opposing Intimidate while we test whether Defiant's +2 is actually being realized (it was not this game — the Intimidate came only after Rillaboom fainted).

Clear Amulet Kingambit is 1-2 and Kingambit was not even brought this game; Scarf Garchomp (33-44) remains the only loadout with a meaningful sample and gives us the natural speed insurance the playbook demands when we keep ending games with 0 Tailwind turns.

Kingambit has now died 132 times and in this game Life Orb recoil (20 HP) is literally the difference between surviving and fainting to a 90% Heat Wave roll; Clear Amulet removes self-chip pressure and blocks Intimidate stat games, worth a short trial given scarf_garchomp sits at 46%.

Clear Amulet Kingambit is 1-3 (25%) and died turn 1 to a Fire move that Clear Amulet does nothing about; Scarf Garchomp (45-52) gives us the Rock Slide speed answer to Volcarona/Pyroar that this loss exposed.
Switched to Life Orb Garchomp + Chople Berry Kingambit + Rillaboom + Incineroar variant based on match review
